description: This file contains C source code with functions related to parsing JSON-based requests for a device management protocol (WDMP). It includes functions for parsing various request types (get, set, attributes, table operations, test-and-set, etc.) and for formulating response objects. It also includes utility functions for translating status codes to messages. The file appears to be a test stub or mock implementation that provides functions for handling JSON requests and responses in a device management context.

methods.name: void parse_get_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj,PAYLOAD_TYPE type)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to populate a request structure for a get operation based on the request type (SNMP or others).

methods.name: void parse_set_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj,PAYLOAD_TYPE type)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to populate a request structure for a set operation, extracting parameters including OIDs, names, values, and data types.

methods.name: void parse_set_attr_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to populate a request structure for setting attributes, especially notification attributes.

methods.name: void parse_test_and_set_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to populate a request structure for a test-and-set operation, including CID values and parameters.

methods.name: void parse_replace_rows_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to populate a table request structure for replacing rows in a table.

methods.name: void parse_add_row_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)

methods.name: void parse_delete_row_request(cJSON * request,req_struct ** reqObj)
methods.description: Parses a JSON request to delete a specific row from a table.
